resources.string:
Ironlog and Health Connect

What Ironlog writes: each workout you finish (its name, start and end time, type, and a short list of the exercises and sets), plus the distance of runs, walks, rides and rows.

What Ironlog reads: heart rate during your workouts, to show your average and peak heart rate on each workout, and body weight, to fill in the weight chart on your Body tab.

This data is saved to your own Ironlog account and is only visible to you. It is never sold, shared with anyone else, or used for ads. You can turn any of this off at any time in Health Connect.
